senses.gloss: जिगमिषु जिगमिषु, i. e. जिगमिष, desid. of गम्, + उ, adj. Being about to go, Rām. 2, 21, 63.

जिगीषा जिगीषा, i. e. जिगीष, desid. of जि, + अ, f.
 1. Wish to overcome, Chr. 31, 20.
 2. Wish to win, Kathās. 21, 81.
 3. Wish to attain, MBh. 3, 13360.
 4. Emulation, Chr. 28, 19.
 --Comp.

जिगीषु जिगीषु, i. e. जिगीष (see the last), + उ, adj.
 1. Desiring to conquer, MBh. 1, 6845.
 2. Desiring to excel, Rām. 1, 13, 21.
 3. Ambitious, Kathās. 4, 126.
जिगीषुता जिगीषु + ता, f. Emulation, Kathās. 18, 85.
